services.title: Mechanical/HVAC Design
services.summary: Centralized chilled water plants, VRF/VRV configurations, cleanroom positive pressure ventilation, and primary-variable hydronic pumping loops.
services.scope: Carrier HAP thermal load profiles, static pressure calculations, duct layouts, acoustic attenuation, chiller optimization, IAQ filtration, and ECBC/ASHRAE 90.1 energy compliance.
services.tools: Carrier HAP, Revit MEP, AutoCAD, DuctSize, Pipe-Flo

services.title: Electrical Design
services.summary: 11kV/33kV indoor and outdoor substation yards, HT/LT switchgear, synchronized DG backup architectures, cable tray layouts, and photometrics.
services.scope: ETAP short-circuit calculations, relay coordination, IS 3043 earthing grid calculations, IS/IEC 62305 lightning protection, voltage drop schedules, and CEIG statutory compliance.
services.standards: IS 732, IS 3043, IS/IEC 62305, Central Electricity Authority (CEA)
services.tools: ETAP, Dialux EVO, AutoCAD Electrical, Revit MEP

services.title: Plumbing Design

services.scope: Dual plumbing piping (flushing/domestic), pump head calculations, gravity sewer gradients, stormwater drainage modeling, and municipal sewer connectivity.
services.standards: NBC 2016 Part 9, Uniform Plumbing Code India (UPC-I), CGWA Guidelines

services.title: Structural Drafting Services
services.summary: RCC framed detailing, IS 13920 ductile rebar drafting, Bar Bending Schedules (BBS), and structural steel connection detailing.
services.scope: Column/beam reinforcement sections, post-tensioned slab tendon layouts, foundation rebar detailing, steel truss connections, and PEB structural drawings.

services.title: Architectural Drafting Services
services.summary: Comprehensive architectural working drawings, municipal sanction permit sets, authority clearance liaison drafting, and life-safety egress plans.

services.title: MEP BIM Services
services.summary: Parametric 3D MEP modeling across LOD 100 to 500 in Autodesk Revit, complete with engineering data, maintenance metadata, and CPWD specifications.
services.scope: HVAC ducting, chilled water piping, cable trays, conduit banks, plumbing risers, and plant room federated modeling with strict ISO 19650 BEP adherence.
services.standards: ISO 19650 Part 1 & 2, BIM Forum LOD Specs, CPWD BIM Mandate
services.tools: Autodesk Revit, BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC)

services.title: Point Cloud to BIM
services.summary: Converting 3D terrestrial LiDAR and drone laser scan point clouds into hyper-accurate, millimeter-precise as-built BIM models.
services.scope: Point cloud decimation, coordinate registration, deviation heat-map validation, plant room retrofits, historical heritage preservation, and industrial expansions.
deliverables: Point Cloud vs Model Deviation Reports
services.standards: ASTM E57, USIBD Level of Accuracy (LOA) Guidelines
services.tools: Autodesk Recap Pro, CloudCompare, Revit, Faro Scene

services.title: PDF to CAD Drafting
services.summary: Vectorization and conversion of legacy scanned paper drawings, municipal blueprints, and flattened PDF sets into editable DWG and Revit models.
services.scope: Scale normalization, layer restructuring per AIA/CPWD CAD standards, dimension verification, block creation, and text digitization.
services.standards: AIA CAD Layer Guidelines, CPWD Architectural Standards

services.title: Clash Detection & Coordination
services.summary: Comprehensive inter-disciplinary clash detection across Architecture, Structure, HVAC, Fire Fighting, Electrical, and Plumbing models in Navisworks Manage.
services.scope: Hard, soft, and clearance clash matrices, multidisciplinary BCF issue tracking, weekly coordination meetings, and zero-rework pre-pour sign-offs.
services.standards: ISO 19650 BCF Standard, AGC BIM Coordination Protocols
services.tools: Autodesk Navisworks Manage, Revizto, BIM Track, BIMcollab

services.title: 3D Rendering
